sources.entry: Topit - Pin any window to the top of your screen [![Open-Source Software][OSS Icon]](https://github.com/lihaoyun6/Topit) ![Freeware][Freeware Icon]

summary.one_liner: Topit is a macOS utility that pins any application window on top of your screen so it stays visible while you work in other windows.
summary.what_it_does: Topit lets you select a window from any running application and pin it to the top of the workspace. You can pin any number of windows and keep moving, resizing, or interacting with them while they stay on top. The README says it uses macOS Accessibility and Screen Recording permissions to control and capture windows. It captures window content through ScreenCapture Kit, which the README says has lower CPU overhead. Installation is via a downloadable file or Homebrew.
use_cases: keep a video or reference window visible above other apps
pin a chat or notes window over a full-screen workflow
keep a monitoring or dashboard window always on top
float a document while writing in another app
pin multiple windows at once on macOS
how_to_run: Or download the latest installation file from the project's release page
Open Topit and select the window you want to pin
notable: Pins windows from any application, not just a single app
Supports pinning any number of windows at once
Uses ScreenCapture Kit for lower CPU overhead, per the README
caveats: Needs Accessibility and Screen Recording permissions
Pinning many windows may drain the battery faster
